summary: Nayax Ltd. announced a definitive agreement to acquire IPS Group, Inc. from Windjammer Capital Investors in an all-cash transaction for $350 million. The acquisition pairs Nayax's payments infrastructure with IPS's smart parking technology, expanding Nayax's addressable cashless opportunity to approximately $342 billion by 2029. The deal will accelerate IPS's expansion into Continental Europe and offers cross-sell opportunities. No board recommendation or advisors are named in the excerpt. The transaction is subject to customary regulatory approvals and closing conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and potential antitrust scrutiny in the parking technology market.
